notes.title: Stellar Serenity Update - Aug 24, 2023
notes.content:
Fixed issue with loading a game that was saved while off the ship.
Fixed Controller echoes issues in Crafting System.
Improved the Portuguese and Italian translation and fixed some texts that were not being translated.
Fixed some issues with sound effects.
A lot of tiny improvements.

tags.bug: Fixed issue with loading a game that was saved while off the ship.
Fixed Controller echoes issues in Crafting System.
Fixed some issues with sound effects.

notes.title: Various improvements and additions
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added missing sound effects.
[*] Added different special items that the Drone can carry.
[*] Fixed bugs related to Inventory when unequipping items that were selected in the list.
[*] Changed default MSAA options and star resolution in main menu.
[*] Added new items related to the Rover and Steam achievements (disabled in Playtest).
[*] And more...
[/list]

notes.title: The joystick update.
notes.content: Several problems with the use of joystick and others with the new items added in the last big update have been fixed.

notes.title: big patch 6-16-23
notes.content:
Fixed many issues regarding joystick usage and translations.
New equippable items were also implemented.
This is possibly the last big patch before release.
There are small things to fix that I'm already working on, but I didn't want to delay these big updates.
